description: This file declares functions, macros, and constants for network subsystem initialization and configuration in Zephyr OS, including support for IPv4, IPv6, and router setup.

methods.name: net_config_init
methods.description: Initializes network configuration with application info, flags, and timeout.

methods.name: net_config_init_by_iface
methods.description: Initializes network configuration using a specific network interface.

methods.name: net_config_init_app
methods.description: Initializes network configuration for a specific device and application info.
